@upscalerjs/esrgan-slim 1.0.0: models/x2 and models/x4 (MIT, ESRGAN-Slim-LICENSE).

Only static assets are served. Image inference occurs in the visitor's browser.
No third-party image upload, API key or per-image processing charge is used.
